verdict.rationale: Pigment is an enterprise planning SaaS platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis. The evidence mentions only "open APIs", an Audit Trail API, and an MCP server; no official client SDK in any language is documented. Raw APIs and MCP are adjacent features, not SDKs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
